div.div:
Key matches —
same order returned

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 487px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-warn-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Say the words "idempotency key" before you are asked. The double-charge is the failure this whole question is built around, and a disabled button does not prevent it — the second attempt comes from a refresh, a back button, or a phone that lost signal at exactly the wrong moment.
